We could not recommend SunPeople more highly. They provided excellent advice and outlined a range of options for us. They also gave us a clear timeline for installation and using solar. The trades people who installed the panels were fantastic, with the solar installed and running in one day. They also left the place spotless and were really helpful in explaining how to use the solar correctly. We were impressed with sales representative right through to office staff who coordinated the install. It was seamless and we were fully informed every step of the way. We were delighted with every aspect of the process and  were very grateful for the care and attention to detail from the SunPeople team. We highly recommend SunPeople and have recommended the to family considering solar in the near future.

Sales rep explained process well and answered our queries. He gave the pros and cons of different panels and inverters.Instal proceeded smoothly and on time. Very happy with workmanship.Office support staff helpful with setting up a monitoring app.

The salesperson was thorough in answering my questions and explaining issues.  The installation was timely and efficient.  The system seems to be operating as expected.  I will have the battery installed after November.
Good, both explained the processthe installation we spot onNo. charger was n/a

I used SunPeople because my brother-in-law had used them a couple of years earlier and was very happy with them. As most of us are very wary when about to invest in something we would prefer to use somebody that a family member or friend has used, as we don’t want to find out the hard way that we picked the wrong company to do our work. With this in mind I went to SunPeople and found out myself that they were absolutely fantastic from start to finish, and there after installation service is great. If you want to have peace of mind definitely go to SunPeople.  Gordon C

The sales and quoting system was efficient and easy to follow. No pressure for sales unlike other companies.Installation was on time and installers (Sam and Dave) were excellent and certainly made the process easy.They were informative, polite and professional.

The sales person Phil was very good, frank and helpful.The installation was delayed by rain on three occasions but was re-scheduled in a timely way, and occurred on the next sunny day.  It was done promptly and professionally.

SunPeople did a fantastic job with our solar system installation, any issues before, during and after installation were quickly dealt with in person, efficiently and without fuss, absolutely amazing service.

We decided to get a system that would future proof our home so we over built a bit. We got micro-inverters and a controller so that we could install more panels, a battery and a car charger in the future with minimal fuss if we needed to. The installation went well with a profesional attitude from the installer and the office staff were helpful where necesary. Neighbours have commented on how tidy th installation looks.
Sales excellent, a bit of a hiccup with installation but rectified promptly, installers friendly and informative

Phil was great about providing useful info without trying to actually sell me something. I was able to make my own informed decision.  I've even recommended him to friends.The install was great. The two gents were polite and cleaned up and the handover was easy to understand.

SunPeople were great to deal with and the service provided was always professional. From Andrew's advice in the planning and quotation stage to the install by Sam and Brayden we could not fault SunPeople. Our experience was hassle free and every step of the way we were informed as to the process. Office staff friendly and attentive to any questions we had along the way. Highly recommend them to anyone considering solar.
Everything went well from the quoting to installation. The team organised grid connection after the install.
We are very happy with the work carried out by SunPeople. The installation went smoothly and the install staff were lovely to deal with.

All dates were adhered to and the installation was carried out quickly and efficiently.Any questions I had were answered professionally and in good time.I would certainly recommend Sun People to anyone looking for solar products.

The salesman talked to us about everything, the installation was easy and done to how we wanted the layout of panels and where the inverter was to be. They passed on to AGL our information in helping set up the grid.

On our experience, on every criterion, the SunPeople beat any others in the industry hands down - from getting them in for a quote, the quoting process, the contracting and then the installation and after-service checks. Unsurpassed.
Great people to deal with and did a great job. They actually listened to our requests and provided easy to follow information before going ahead with the job. Highly recommended.

Tim and his team for their friendly and professional installation of our solar panels.They managed a difficult installation on an old tile roof, maximising the available space while respecting a strict customer criteria.We are very happy with the outcome.
The entire tire process was made very easy and smooth

The SunPeople installation was the additional of extra capacity to an existing system. The quoting process was straightforward and began with a discussion of my current and future needs and usage.  Installation was completed on time and with no issues.  Would definitely recommend.  I needed the two systems integrating to be able to use one portal/app to manage, which was not done at time of install.  This was completed promptly after I raised - works great.

Highly recommended though I feel it is quite expensive. Installation, pre and post contact by the consultant was impressive. Quickly installed with little disruption, tradies very polite and helpful. Very good follow up by the Admin.

The sales process was very good. The Sun People adjusted the system to our needs and also upgraded our panels.Installation was very professional. The installers were on time, very tidy and polite.After sales service experience was good too. We got a follow up call the next day about our installation followed by emails about the process to get a Smart Meter installed. The system performance is matching our expectations and I can highly recommend the Sun People.

Phil from Sunpeople visited the property, listened to what I wanted (and why), and made some sensible suggestions. A detailed quote was provided.The installation was quicker than I expected - though this wasn't a concern to me.The site installers came up with a better cable route for running cabling under the house. Site installation is tidy, and all installers provided the correct certificate of completion for the electrical work that they undertook. I plan on doing a bit more with my system - possibly add a battery, and put in some smart switching logic by accessing data from the inverter and meter. Dave and Dyllan from Sunpeople have been helpful with working out how to do this (which has proved straight forward in the end) Sunpeople organised approval to connect to the grid (from Endeavour) - I just had to organise a smart meter install via my retailer (Red Energy). Good to deal with / helpful.

Although not the cheapest price, I was more than happy to use a local supplier.They kept me informed as the job progressed.Installers were approachable and easy to talk with about what they were doing on the day.  I arranged to have the roof painted between the brackets install and the final fitting.  I appreciated that sunpeople were happy to accommodate that request.A happy customer

We found SunPeople to be really honest and provide extremely attentive service both before during and after our install. Phil walked us through all our options was was realistic with what our needs were. We’ve happily recommended them to others now too!

We had been thinking of solar for many years.. We had actually signed with another company and then decided to get a quote from SunPeople.. the quote offered better value for money with a larger system and a better payback.. We couldn't be happier with the end result.Installation was carried out professionaly and at the time agreed..Thanks Sun People

The team are extremely knowledgeable and went through a couple of iterations to get the system that we wanted (a large 3 phase system with 2 inverters for a rural  property which would effectively operate as if it were off grid).The quotation and breakdown was very clear and the process of booking the system in was easy.The office team kept us informed of the process and schedule.The installation team were amazing and did a great job of installing the system and hand over.The system has been running for 2 months now and it was worth every penny. Highly recommend.

Sun People were only installer who actually came onsite to quote!..provided costing for 4 options which made my decision easy, kept me informed throughout the process and were very patient when building works, rain and covid held up the project for months, installation was quick and efficient. Support throughout has been excellent.
They took the time to get the right system for any current & future needs. Not the cheapest "off the shelf" package, but I felt the right one for maximising  long term benefit

Phil from SunPeople was extremely helpful and immediately responded to any questions. Even dropping around to check on the installation and see how the system was working. His team were very helpful and the installers were great also. Very professional and polite and did a great job. Couldn't recommend highly enough!

After researching solar options for weeks, I reached out to a number of companies to get quotes and some design advice (eg. how much solar would they recommend on my roof and why). I mostly got standard options and quotes back, but Sun People straight away showed they were different and go above and beyond. They came out within a day to talk to me in person, looked at the house and roof, and talked about what I wanted to achieve. During my conversation with Phil it became quickly clear he had very in-depth knowledge of everything (from technology all the way to a novel finance option I wasn't aware off).Phil showed great patience in answering my ongoing barrage of questions over a the course of a couple of weeks. They constantly requoted to show me how a change in the design of the installtion would effect the overall picture and cost. When I finally gave the go ahead, it didn't take long before the installation was up and running. They now periodically check in to hear if all is fine.Altogether, I couldn't have picked a better installer. Sun People delivered in every aspect. I would highly recommend them for anyone considering solar in the Illawarra region.

Phil from SunPeople was the only quoting installer to come to our house prior to providing a quote. This meant we had confidence the quote would be realistic, the installation wouldn’t hit unforeseen obstacles and that SunPeople were serious about doing business with us. We also had a very old asbestos metre board which needed to be replaced prior to the installation to avoid problems later with supply. Phil pointed this out to us. We knew where all parts of the system would be located too.All of this meant a quality on time installation using the components we had selected with SunPeople’s advice.Everyone involved from the office to the site could not have been more professional, helpful and polite.The complete job was done on time and we were encouraged to seek advice and support for anything to do with our system and supply after the job was done.We cannot recommend SunPeople highly enough.

Navigating solar quotes was difficult due to the large variation in approach and quotes. SunPeople were informative, helpful and frank at all times in the quoting process. The installation was seamless and after sales service exemplary.
From Quote to installation I could not fault the team at Sun People. Nothing was a hassle!  I highly recommend.
Great customer service. Good range of options. Phil was thorough in his explanations. The installations team was efficient, fast and really lovely. Highly recommended.

The whole process was excellent from start to finish. I spoke to Dave who was very knowledgeable and responded with a quote very quickly. He also came and inspected or property prior to installation. The package was all quality and the organisation of the install was effortless. The crew were here early in the morning and were very professional, finishing the job in a few hours. The follow up from the administration crew was first class. I would recommend Sun People for a great hassle free installation.

Dealing with Sun People from the start was a very pleasant and painless process.It was comforting to know that they had a shopfront and would be there if there was a problem in the future.Their technical knowledge was competent and follow up customer service after the jobs completion was exceptional especially when we had trouble with our energy retailer and our FIT.

SunPeople are amazing, I had such a lovely experience right from the start, a friend recommended I get them over to quote me on some solar and Andrew and the team were nothing but friendly and super helpful! Made sure I got a system that would suit my needs and at the best possible price.Andrew explained different finance options that allowed me to get solar with a weekly/fortnightly or monthly payment rather than paying for it all upfront and that worked perfect for me.Not long after I accepted the quote, the team had everything in motion and worked around the rainy weather to ensure I had everything installed as quickly and smoothly as possible and I couldn't be happier.The drop I've seen on my power bill makes it all worth it and I only wish I had done it sooner.If you're thinking about solar I would 100% recommend SunPeople!
Dealing with Sun People was a pleasure, from the initial contact meeting right through to final installation and commissioning.  We are delighted with the results.

The whole experience of dealing with SunPeople, from the initial sales call and advice, through to the timely, minimal disruption (albeit complex) installation, was as good as it could  have been. The most amazing part was that it was all commissioned and up and running literally 1 day before bad weather and an extended period of power outages. The back up battery, configured perfectly as agreed, meant that we had power through three multi-day outages almost back to back. If it hadn’t been for the new kit, working as designed, we would literally have had to live somewhere else for days. We couldn’t be more thrilled with our purchase!
Fantastic service, beautiful installation and great results - We are very happy!

Phil, from SunPeople, was very quick to reply and was more than happy to visit us at our home. His knowledge and obvious passion for what he does was clearly evident. He was patient in explaining the finer points about the install process and what our solar requirements would be. He also didn't sell us too large a system, nor did he upsell us on components that we didn't need. By comparing his quote with the others that we received we were able to back this up.Come the install day, the team was on time, professional and cleaned up after themselves. Afterwards I inspected both the panels on the roof and the inverter on the wall and the workmanship was spot-on.I've already recommended them to family and friends and wouldn't hesitate to recommend them to anyone else who's in the market for a solar install.

From the initial site visit & quotation through to the installation. The communication, installation  team were fantastic.The  solar system is fantastic already saving $ & helping the environment. Would highly recommend.Thank you

SunPeople were recommend to me and I'm happy I listened to the referral. SunPeople made the process of choosing and installing solar panels simple. I found the staff polite, knowledgeable and friendly. I wouldn't hesitate to recommend them to my family, friends and neighbours.

Sales person showed up exactly when he said he would, gave us all the information we needed and explained everything thoroughly.Installation was very efficient. On time, friendly and helpful. Would highly recommend Sun People.

5.5 KVA. 20 Trina panels all the rest Emphases The micro inverts were out of stock, took a few weeks to arrive, came to install day on the house, ( arrived 7:30 gone 11:30 ) broke a main switch ( no spares ) started to shower with rain, they downed tools, still waiting for the panels and all the electrics to be fixed on the house Next visit on the 23/07/18. Hopefully.

Having a high level disability & dependent on power hungry electrical equipment. My parents & I decided to investigate getting solar power installed to help save some money on ever-increasing power bills.We got 3 quotes, Thankfully Sunpeople were our first company to give a quote. I had done plenty of research because I believe you need to have some knowledge before venturing into such an investment.Their Rep Mark Heaton came to give us a quote, we were very impressed with his knowledge & explanation of the solar products that were on offer, once we decided what we would like to have, Mark said that he had to get up on the roof for an inspection to see if it would fit. Which of course they did.While researching it was emphasised numerous times that whoever does a quote, should physically get up on the roof to check it out.
